summary_en: ¥2,140M limit, 1,254,000 shares (0.83% of S/O ex-treasury), open-market purchase via discretionary agency, execution window 1 Sept – 30 Nov 2026. Rationale: capital-policy agility and capital-efficiency improvement; aligns with medium-term plan FY3/26–FY3/29 shareholder-return framework announced 14 May 2026.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, the board of Relo Group resolved to acquire up to 1,254,000 treasury shares (0.83% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for an aggregate amount not exceeding ¥2,140 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase under a discretionary agency agreement (取引一任契約) during the period from 1 September to 30 November 2026. The company stated the rationale as implementing flexible capital policy responsive to changes in the operating environment and improving capital efficiency, consistent with the shareholder-return framework for the medium-term plan covering fiscal years ending March 2026 through March 2029, which was announced on 14 May 2026. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 1,295,875 treasury shares, excluding 16,410 shares held by the J-ESOP trust.
